description: Defines interfaces and structures for SDR Radio Unit executor mappers, including sector and overall mapper classes, configurations for different executor setups, and factory functions to create mappers based on configurations.

classes.name: ru_sdr_sector_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for accessing sector-specific SDR executor components, including downlink, uplink, PRACH, transmitter, and receiver executors.

classes.name: ru_sdr_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for managing multiple sector mappers and overall radio executor, including access to sector mappers and a baseband housekeeping executor.

methods.name: get_sector_mapper
methods.description: Retrieves the sector executor mapper for a specified sector index.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Provides array-like access to sector mappers via sector index.

methods.name: asynchronous_radio_executor
methods.description: Retrieves the baseband radio housekeeping executor.
